description: CLI tool that manages agentic coding loops with planning, execution, tracking, and a real-time React dashboard

items.description: Create monorepo root with package.json (workspaces: cli, ui, shared), tsconfig.base.json, and .gitignore
steps_to_verify: package.json exists at project root with 'workspaces' field containing ['cli', 'ui', 'shared']
tsconfig.base.json exists with target ES2022, module Node16, strict true
.gitignore includes node_modules/, dist/, and .ralfie/

items.description: Create shared package with package.json and tsconfig.json
steps_to_verify: shared/package.json exists with name '@ralfie/shared', type 'module'
shared/tsconfig.json extends ../tsconfig.base.json
shared/package.json has build and typecheck scripts

items.description: Create CLI package with package.json (commander, ws deps) and tsconfig.json, bin entry 'ralf'
steps_to_verify: cli/package.json exists with name '@ralfie/cli', type 'module', bin.ralf pointing to dist/index.js
cli/package.json has commander and ws as dependencies, vitest as devDependency
cli/tsconfig.json extends ../tsconfig.base.json

items.description: Create UI package with package.json (React, Vite, Tailwind deps), tsconfig.json, and vite.config.ts with proxy settings
steps_to_verify: ui/package.json exists with react, react-dom, react-router-dom, recharts, react-markdown as dependencies
ui/vite.config.ts configures React and Tailwind plugins, proxies /api and /ws to localhost:3333
ui/tsconfig.json has jsx: 'react-jsx' and module: 'ESNext'

items.description: Install all dependencies and verify workspace typecheck passes
steps_to_verify: Running 'npm install' succeeds without errors
Running 'npm run typecheck' passes for all workspaces

items.description: Define shared TypeScript types: ItemStatus, PrdItem, PrdItemComment, Prd, BoardMeta, Board, RalfieConfig, WsEvent, WsEventType
steps_to_verify: shared/src/types.ts exports ItemStatus as union type: 'pending' | 'in_progress' | 'done' | 'failed' | 'verified'
PrdItem interface includes id, category, description, steps_to_verify (string[]), status, assigned_to (string|null), comments
RalfieConfig interface includes agent_command, default_iterations, feedback_loops (string[]), serve_port
WsEventType includes board:updated, prd:updated, progress:updated, lock:acquired, lock:released, run:started, run:iteration, run:completed
Running 'npm run build --workspace=shared' produces shared/dist/types.js and shared/dist/types.d.ts

items.description: Implement paths.ts module with helper functions for all .ralfie/ directory paths (ralfieDir, configPath, boardsDir, boardDir, planPath, prdPath, progressPath, locksDir, lockPath)
steps_to_verify: cli/src/lib/paths.ts exports ralfieDir, configPath, boardsDir, boardDir, planPath, prdPath, progressPath, locksDir, lockPath
ralfieDir returns '<cwd>/.ralfie'
boardDir returns '<cwd>/.ralfie/boards/<boardName>'
lockPath returns '<cwd>/.ralfie/boards/<boardName>/locks/<itemId>.lock'

items.description: Implement config.ts module with readConfig, writeConfig, and defaultConfig for .ralfie/config.json
steps_to_verify: readConfig returns defaultConfig when no config file exists
writeConfig creates .ralfie directory if needed and writes config.json
readConfig merges partial saved config with defaults (missing fields get default values)
defaultConfig has agent_command='claude', default_iterations=10, feedback_loops=[], serve_port=3333
All 3 config tests pass: 'npm test --workspace=cli -- --run config'

items.description: Implement prd.ts module with readPrd, writePrd, claimItem, completeItem, failItem, verifyItem, addComment — all mutations use O_EXCL file locking for concurrent safety
steps_to_verify: claimItem sets status to 'in_progress' and assigned_to to the session ID
claimItem throws when item is already in_progress
completeItem sets status to 'done' and clears assigned_to
failItem sets status to 'failed', clears assigned_to, and appends a comment with the failure reason
verifyItem sets status to 'verified' only when current status is 'done', throws otherwise
addComment appends a PrdItemComment with timestamp, session_id, and message
All PRD mutations use file locking via O_EXCL to prevent concurrent clobber
All 8 PRD tests pass: 'npm test --workspace=cli -- --run prd'

items.description: Implement board.ts module with createBoard, listBoards, getBoard, boardExists, appendProgress for board CRUD operations
steps_to_verify: createBoard creates board directory with plan.md, prd.json, progress.md (empty), meta.json, and locks/ subdirectory
boardExists returns true when board directory exists, false otherwise
getBoard reads and returns meta, plan, prd, and progress data
listBoards returns array of BoardMeta for all boards with meta.json files
appendProgress appends text to progress.md
All 4 board tests pass: 'npm test --workspace=cli -- --run board'

items.description: Implement lock.ts module with acquireLock (O_EXCL atomic create), releaseLock, isLocked, getLockInfo, clearStaleLocks for per-item lockfile management
steps_to_verify: acquireLock creates a .lock file atomically using O_EXCL, returns true on success
acquireLock returns false (not throws) when lock already exists
releaseLock deletes the lock file
getLockInfo returns session_id and acquired_at from lock file content
clearStaleLocks removes all .lock files in the board's locks directory and returns count
All 5 lock tests pass: 'npm test --workspace=cli -- --run lock'

items.description: Implement agent.ts module with spawnInteractive (stdio inherited), spawnPrintMode (captures stdout, detects <ralfie>COMPLETE</ralfie>), and generateSessionId
steps_to_verify: spawnInteractive spawns the configured agent_command with inherited stdio and returns exit code
spawnPrintMode spawns agent with '-p' flag, captures stdout, and sets result.complete=true when output contains '<ralfie>COMPLETE</ralfie>'
generateSessionId returns a string matching pattern 'ralfie-<timestamp>-<random>'

items.description: Implement skills.ts module and create three bundled skill markdown files: ralfie-plan.md, ralfie-edit.md, ralfie-run.md with installSkills function
steps_to_verify: cli/src/skills/ralfie-plan.md exists with frontmatter (name, description) and phases: Grilling, Plan Generation, PRD Generation
cli/src/skills/ralfie-edit.md exists with phases: Setup (reads board state), Grilling, Update, Drift Log
cli/src/skills/ralfie-run.md exists with workflow: Pick Task, Claim Item, Implement, Run Feedback Loops, Update Progress, Update PRD, Commit, Check Completion, Failure Protocol
installSkills copies all 3 skill files from bundled source to .claude/skills/ directory

items.description: Implement 'ralf init' command that creates .ralfie/ directory structure, writes default config, and installs Claude Code skills
steps_to_verify: Running 'ralf init' creates .ralfie/ directory, .ralfie/config.json, and .ralfie/boards/
Running 'ralf init' installs skills to .claude/skills/ralfie-plan.md, ralfie-edit.md, ralfie-run.md
Running 'ralf init' twice does not overwrite modified config.json
Both init tests pass: 'npm test --workspace=cli -- --run init'

items.description: Implement CLI entry point (cli/src/index.ts) with Commander program definition, 'ralf' name, version 0.0.1, and init command wired
steps_to_verify: cli/src/index.ts imports Commander and defines program with name 'ralf'
Running 'node cli/dist/index.js --help' shows available commands
Running 'node cli/dist/index.js init' executes the init command

items.description: Implement 'ralf plan' command that verifies skill installation and spawns interactive Claude Code session with --prompt to invoke /ralfie-plan skill
steps_to_verify: Running 'ralf plan' without prior 'ralf init' exits with error about missing skills
Command spawns Claude Code in interactive mode (stdio inherited) with initial prompt referencing /ralfie-plan skill

items.description: Implement 'ralf edit <board>' command that verifies board exists and skill installed, then spawns interactive Claude Code session with /ralfie-edit skill for the specified board
steps_to_verify: Running 'ralf edit nonexistent-board' exits with error about board not found
Command spawns Claude Code in interactive mode with prompt referencing the board path and /ralfie-edit skill

items.description: Implement 'ralf run <board> [iterations]' command that runs serial agent loop: spawns Claude Code in print mode per iteration, detects COMPLETE signal, respects max iterations from config or CLI arg
steps_to_verify: Running 'ralf run nonexistent-board' exits with error
Command uses default_iterations from config when no iterations argument provided
Each iteration sends prompt with @prd.json, @progress.md, @plan.md references and session ID
Loop exits early when agent output contains '<ralfie>COMPLETE</ralfie>'
Loop prints iteration counter (e.g., 'Iteration 3/10') for each iteration

items.description: Implement 'ralf list' command that displays all boards with progress bars showing done/total counts, active count, and failed count
steps_to_verify: Output includes board name, visual progress bar, done/total count, active count, and failed count
Empty state shows 'No boards found' message
List test passes: 'npm test --workspace=cli -- --run list'

items.description: Implement 'ralf status <board> <status>' command that filters and displays PRD items by status (pending, in_progress, done, failed, verified)
steps_to_verify: Filters items correctly — only items matching the specified status are shown
Each item displays id, category, description, assigned agent (if any), and comment count
Invalid status value shows error with valid options listed
Status test passes: 'npm test --workspace=cli -- --run status'

items.description: Implement 'ralf verify <board> <item-id>' command that marks a done item as verified in the PRD
steps_to_verify: Verifying a 'done' item changes its status to 'verified'
Verifying a non-'done' item (e.g., pending) exits with error
Verifying on a nonexistent board exits with error
Verify test passes: 'npm test --workspace=cli -- --run verify'

items.description: Implement 'ralf unlock <board>' command that clears all lockfiles for a board
steps_to_verify: All .lock files in the board's locks/ directory are deleted
Output shows count of cleared locks
Unlock test passes: 'npm test --workspace=cli -- --run unlock'

items.description: Implement file watcher (cli/src/server/watcher.ts) that watches .ralfie/boards/ for file changes and invokes callback with event type, board name, and filename
steps_to_verify: Watches boards directory for new board creation events
Watches each existing board directory for prd.json, progress.md, plan.md changes
Watches locks/ subdirectory for lock file creation/deletion
Returns array of FSWatcher instances for cleanup

items.description: Implement WebSocket server (cli/src/server/ws.ts) with createWsServer and broadcast function that sends WsEvent JSON to all connected clients
steps_to_verify: createWsServer attaches WebSocketServer to the HTTP server instance
broadcast sends JSON-serialized WsEvent to all clients with readyState OPEN
WsEvent includes type, board, data, and timestamp fields

items.description: Implement REST API (cli/src/server/api.ts) with endpoints: GET /api/boards, GET /api/boards/:name, POST /api/boards/:name/verify/:itemId, POST /api/boards/:name/run, GET /api/config, PUT /api/config
steps_to_verify: GET /api/boards returns array of all boards with PRD and progress data
GET /api/boards/:name returns full board data (meta, plan, prd, progress)
GET /api/boards/:name returns 404 for nonexistent board
POST /api/boards/:name/verify/:itemId verifies the item and returns {ok: true}
POST /api/boards/:name/run accepts {iterations} body and starts a background run
GET /api/config returns current RalfieConfig
PUT /api/config accepts new config JSON and persists it

items.description: Implement HTTP static file server (cli/src/server/http.ts) that serves React UI build from cli/dist/ui/ with SPA fallback to index.html
steps_to_verify: Serves static files from cli/dist/ui/ with correct MIME types
Routes API requests to the API handler before static file serving
Non-file routes fall back to index.html for SPA client-side routing
Returns 404 with helpful message if UI build is missing

items.description: Implement 'ralf serve' command that starts HTTP+WebSocket server, wires file watcher to broadcast WebSocket events, listens on configured port
steps_to_verify: Server starts on the port from config (default 3333)
File changes in .ralfie/ trigger appropriate WebSocket event types (prd:updated, progress:updated, board:updated, lock:acquired/released)
Console output shows URLs for HTTP and WebSocket endpoints

items.description: Create React app entry point with index.html, main.tsx (StrictMode + BrowserRouter), index.css (Tailwind import + dark theme CSS variables), and App.tsx with route definitions
steps_to_verify: ui/index.html has root div and script tag for main.tsx
ui/src/main.tsx renders App inside StrictMode and BrowserRouter
ui/src/index.css imports Tailwind and defines CSS variables: --bg, --bg-card, --border, --text, --text-muted, --accent, --success, --warning, --danger
App.tsx defines routes: / (Dashboard), /boards (BoardList), /boards/:name (BoardDetail), /settings (Settings)

items.description: Create API client (ui/src/lib/api.ts) with fetch wrappers: fetchBoards, fetchBoard, verifyItem, triggerRun, fetchConfig, updateConfig
steps_to_verify: fetchBoards calls GET /api/boards and returns parsed JSON
fetchBoard(name) calls GET /api/boards/:name
verifyItem(board, itemId) calls POST /api/boards/:board/verify/:itemId
triggerRun(board, iterations) calls POST /api/boards/:board/run with JSON body
fetchConfig and updateConfig call GET/PUT /api/config respectively

items.description: Create WebSocket hook (ui/src/lib/ws.ts) with useWs that auto-connects, parses WsEvent JSON messages, auto-reconnects after 2s on disconnect, and exposes connected state
steps_to_verify: useWs accepts an onEvent callback and calls it with parsed WsEvent on each message
WebSocket auto-reconnects after 2-second delay on close
Hook returns { connected: boolean } state
Uses ref for callback to avoid reconnection on callback changes

items.description: Create Layout component with sidebar navigation (Dashboard, Boards, Settings) and main content area, using monospace font and dark theme
steps_to_verify: Sidebar is 56px (w-56) wide with border-right
Nav items highlight with accent color when active (matching current route)
Main content area is scrollable and has padding
'ralfie' title appears at top of sidebar

items.description: Implement DashboardPage with aggregated stats across all boards, items-per-day bar chart (last 7 days), and board overview cards with progress bars — auto-refreshes via WebSocket
steps_to_verify: Displays StatsCards showing total, completed, in-progress, failed, and verified item counts
Displays ItemsPerDayChart bar chart using recharts with last 7 days of activity
Lists all boards as cards with name, done/total count, percentage, and visual progress bar
Board cards link to /boards/:name detail page
Data refreshes automatically when WebSocket events are received

items.description: Implement BoardListPage showing all boards with status breakdown (pending/active/done/failed/verified counts) — auto-refreshes via WebSocket
steps_to_verify: Each board displays name, description, total item count, and per-status counts
Board cards link to /boards/:name detail page
Empty state shows message directing user to run 'ralf plan'
Data refreshes on WebSocket events

items.description: Implement BoardDetailPage with tabbed view (PRD Items kanban, Plan markdown viewer, Progress timeline), Run button with dialog, and verify button on done items — auto-refreshes via WebSocket on matching board events
steps_to_verify: Three tabs: 'PRD Items' (kanban), 'Plan' (markdown), 'Progress' (markdown timeline)
Kanban view shows 5 columns: Pending, In Progress, Done, Failed, Verified
Each kanban card shows item ID, category, description, assigned agent, and comment count
Done items have a 'Verify' button that calls the verify API and refreshes
Run button opens RunDialog with iteration count input
Plan tab renders plan.md as formatted markdown
Progress tab renders progress.md as formatted markdown
Only refreshes when WebSocket events match the current board name

items.description: Implement SettingsPage with form for editing RalfieConfig: agent_command (text), default_iterations (number), serve_port (number), feedback_loops (textarea, one per line) with save button and confirmation
steps_to_verify: Loads current config on mount via fetchConfig
Displays input fields for agent_command, default_iterations, serve_port
Feedback loops shown as textarea with one command per line
Save button calls PUT /api/config and shows 'Saved!' confirmation for 2 seconds

items.description: Implement StatsCards component displaying 5 KPI cards (Total Items, Completed, In Progress, Failed, Verified) with color-coded values
steps_to_verify: Renders 5 cards in a grid layout
Each card shows label and value with appropriate color (success for completed/verified, accent for in-progress, danger for failed)
Cards have dark bg-card background with border styling

items.description: Implement ItemsPerDayChart component using recharts BarChart showing items with activity per day for last 7 days
steps_to_verify: Renders a bar chart using recharts ResponsiveContainer
X-axis shows MM-DD date labels
Y-axis shows integer counts (no decimals)
Bars use accent color (#6366f1) with rounded top corners

items.description: Implement PrdKanban component with 5 status columns, item cards showing ID/category/description/agent/comments, and verify button on done items
steps_to_verify: 5 columns rendered: Pending, In Progress, Done, Failed, Verified with color-coded headers
Each column header shows item count
Item cards display ID (monospace bold), category, description, assigned agent (if any), and comment count
Done items have a verify button that calls onVerify callback with item ID

items.description: Implement PlanViewer and ProgressTimeline components that render markdown content using react-markdown with dark prose styling
steps_to_verify: PlanViewer renders markdown string as formatted HTML with prose-invert styling
ProgressTimeline renders markdown or shows 'No progress logged yet' when empty
Both components wrap content in bg-card styled container

items.description: Implement RunDialog modal component with iteration count input, Start Run button that calls triggerRun API, and success confirmation state
steps_to_verify: Modal overlay appears when open=true, dismisses on backdrop click or Cancel
Input field for max iterations with default value 10
Start Run button calls triggerRun API with board name and iteration count
After starting, shows success message and Close button (replacing the form)

items.description: Configure CLI build pipeline: tsc compilation, copy skill .md files to dist/skills/, copy UI build to dist/ui/, prepend #!/usr/bin/env node shebang to dist/index.js
steps_to_verify: cli/package.json has postbuild script that copies skills, UI dist, and adds shebang
After build, cli/dist/skills/ contains ralfie-plan.md, ralfie-edit.md, ralfie-run.md
After build, cli/dist/ui/ contains the Vite React build output
cli/dist/index.js starts with '#!/usr/bin/env node'
cli/dist/index.js is executable (chmod +x)

items.description: Configure root build order: shared builds first, then UI, then CLI (so CLI can copy UI dist)
steps_to_verify: Root package.json build script runs workspaces in order: shared → ui → cli
Root test script builds shared first before running CLI tests
Running 'npm run build' from root produces dist/ in all three workspaces

items.description: End-to-end smoke test: clean build, ralf init creates expected files, ralf list shows empty state, ralf serve responds with HTML, all tests pass
steps_to_verify: After clean build, 'ralf init' creates .ralfie/config.json with defaults, .ralfie/boards/ directory, and .claude/skills/ with 3 skill files
'ralf list' shows 'No boards found' message
'ralf serve' starts and responds to HTTP requests with React app HTML
'npm test' passes all test suites (config, prd, board, lock, init, list, status, verify, unlock)

items.description: Update CLAUDE.md with project description, architecture overview, build/run commands, test commands, and coding conventions
steps_to_verify: CLAUDE.md includes project description for Ralfie
CLAUDE.md documents build commands: npm run build, npm test, npm run typecheck
CLAUDE.md describes monorepo structure: cli/, ui/, shared/ workspaces
CLAUDE.md lists available CLI commands: init, plan, edit, run, list, status, verify, unlock, serve
